decisions: A legacy data producer requires an active real VerifiedRuntime with v1 approval and the shipped legacy adapter profile. It retains verified_enrolled_candidate provenance and exact SDK/dependency/worker/Python identities without inventing public source revision, manifest or build ID.

Persistence transfer additionally requires the measured persistence check. Native registry enrollment and current policy remain required at service startup; the data description never grants execution.

Untagged catalog bindings retain their original durable wire shape and producer fingerprints. Boxed storage changes representation only; serialization compatibility and actual current-image tests pass.

All native Unix config writers share the protected bounded profile writer lane. Stop reads the current preferences inside that lane before narrowing enablement, preserving runtime/source/retention preferences.

Atomic replacement uses pinned owner file/directory identity, expected bytes, exclusive private staging, file/parent sync and descriptor-relative rename. Existing read-only modes and ACL refusals remain effective.

A post-rename error is an unknown commit outcome and never triggers replay or config deletion. A later writer recovers only a bounded protected reserved staging namespace and preserves unrelated files.

development_failures.result: One enrolled case passed; the following catalog case failed with TransportFailed while opening a fresh target persistent broker, before note import. The bridge did not retain a more specific cause. No workers remained. This combined run was rejected; a fresh complete run passed without changing production deadlines or adding mutation retries. The original cause is unresolved and remains part of P9 load/transport qualification.

Initial native config run exposed invalid-channel directory creation and an invalid synthetic source-set fixture. Restore validation-before-creation and give the fixture a valid source-set ID; the final19 cases pass.
Clippy rejected the large catalog/enrollment enum variant. Box both variants without changing serde shape. Final production context Clippy passes.

Native compile initially found a test-only unique_nanos reference in production code and Darwin mode-type mismatch. Use an existing getrandom dependency for exclusive staging names and native SFlag checks. A later native lint found an unnecessary inode cast; remove the casts without suppression.

A scratch native-lint audit incorrectly assumed every error came from unchanged code and tried to read a newly created file from HEAD. The failed audit was not accepted. The corrected final audit verifies all36 remaining error-source hashes against HEAD or the original dirty inventory; none is a new producer/config module.

limitations: The earlier combined actual run had an unresolved broker-open transport failure. A successful fresh run is evidence of these scenarios, not proof the prior cause is fixed; P9 stress and failure-path qualification remain required.
